security_audit.summary: Most static command and network findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, TypeScript template literal types, and a documentation URL. remediation.suggestion: Replace the ../genlayer-erc7710-connector/SKILL.md instruction with a declared dependency or marketplace skill name. Require normal tool-mediated skill loading instead of direct parent-directory access.

content.value_statement: Delegated agents need review rules before they can safely keep authority. This skill helps define GenLayer evidence, rubrics, decisions, and revocation handoffs.
actual_capabilities: Defines review inputs for mandates, action receipts, outputs, costs, and prior decisions.
Drafts rubrics for relevance, scope compliance, safety, budget discipline, and evidence quality.
Specifies decision outputs for continue, warn, constrain, revoke, and escalate outcomes.
Models wallet-spend snapshots for delegated on-chain agent reviews.
Outlines ERC-7710 revocation handoffs when a connector skill defines the implementation path.
limitations: Does not write, lint, test, deploy, or interact with GenLayer contracts.
Does not provide a complete bridge, relayer, or EVM controller implementation.
Requires external evidence sources for receipts, artifacts, costs, and transaction state.
Cannot guarantee trustless revocation without a verified cross-chain effect path.

use_cases.title: Review On-Chain Agents
use_cases.description: Define evidence and scoring for agents that spend funds, deploy contracts, or call external protocols.

use_cases.title: Specify Revocation Workflows
use_cases.description: Map GenLayer decisions to constrain or revoke outcomes before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Prepare Supervisor Requirements
use_cases.description: Create a structured brief for teams building GenLayer Intelligent Contract supervisors.

prompt_templates.title: Define a Review Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a GenLayer supervisor review for an agent with this mandate: [mandate]. Include evidence, rubric, decisions, and failure paths.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Rubric
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a rubric for an on-chain agent that can [actions]. Cover safety, scope, cost, evidence, and result quality.

prompt_templates.title: Map ERC-7710 Effects
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this delegation policy and revocation controller plan, specify how constrain and revoke decisions should reach the target chain.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Supervisor Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this GenLayer supervisor design for missing evidence, weak revocation assumptions, bad relayer behavior, and appeal gaps: [design].

output_examples.input: Ask for a review plan for a delegated deployment agent.
output_examples.output: A purpose statement, evidence checklist, scored rubric, decision states, appeal path, and required tests.

output_examples.input: Ask how to supervise wallet spending for an on-chain agent.
output_examples.output: A spend snapshot field list, budget checks, warning thresholds, and revocation trigger rules.

output_examples.input: Ask how a revoke decision should affect ERC-7710 authority.
output_examples.output: A handoff plan naming the decision source, controller target, relayer assumptions, fallback, and tests.

best_practices: Separate judgment logic from the bridge or controller that applies authority changes.
Require receipts, artifact hashes, costs, and rationales for every reviewed action.
Test continue, warn, constrain, revoke, missing evidence, and bad relayer paths.
anti_patterns: Do not claim revocation is trustless without a defined verification path.
Do not treat qualitative GenLayer decisions as automatic EVM state changes.
Do not omit appeal and emergency revoke paths for long-lived authority.

faq.question: Does this skill deploy GenLayer contracts?
faq.answer: No. It defines review interfaces and supervision requirements. Use dedicated GenLayer tooling for deployment and testing.

faq.question: What decisions can a supervisor emit?
faq.answer: It supports continue, warn, constrain, revoke, and escalate decisions.

faq.question: Can it supervise wallet spending?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes spend snapshots and budget checks for delegated on-chain agents.

faq.question: Does it handle ERC-7710 revocation directly?
faq.answer: No. It describes the handoff. A connector or controller must implement the target-chain effect.

faq.question: What evidence should reviews include?
faq.answer: Use action receipts, transaction hashes, artifacts, rationales, costs, prior warnings, and reproducible evidence hashes or URIs.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Teams designing agent governance, blockchain security reviews, or GenLayer supervisor requirements can use it.
